verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own marketing says it lets users screen customers as part of onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations, which covers the screening half of the story only in general terms. Nothing in the evidence shows business-entity screening specifically, or any view of linked ownership or association risk. Missing for 10: explicit business-entity screening, beneficial ownership or association linkage, network or relationship risk context, and first-party docs or hands-on corroboration beyond a marketing line.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
